# OpenCV

> Free online CV builder and cover letter maker. Build a professional, ATS-friendly
> CV or resume from 12+ templates, pair it with a matching cover letter, and
> download a polished A4 PDF in minutes. No design skills required.

## Key facts
- **Product:** OpenCV — free CV builder, resume maker and cover letter builder.
- **Templates:** 12+ CV layouts (Classic, Modern, ATS Pro, Minimal, Elegant,
  Academic, Technical, Creative, Executive, Sidebar, Two Column, Compact) and
  7 cover letter styles (Classic Block, Modern, Modified Block, Semi-Block,
  Minimal, Executive, Creative).
- **Formats covered:** reverse-chronological (90% of cases), combination/hybrid
  (career changers), academic CV (publications-first), executive, two-column.
- **ATS:** single-column layouts with standard headings parse cleanly through
  Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, iCIMS and Taleo.
- **Export:** one-click PDF download; CV + cover letter can be exported as a
  single combined PDF.
